notes.title: Shooting Love 20XX is Complete! EXZEAL is Now Available With Contest Being Held in Celebration!
notes.content:
Get EXZ-ited! Degica Games is pleased to announce that the fourth and final wave of Triangle Services’s Shooting Love 20XX, EXZEAL, is now available!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465060
To celebrate, we’re holding a contest!

[h1]EXZEAL Contest:[/h1]
[b]Details:[/b] This contest is to compete for the three highest scores in EXZEAL Remix, Stage 1 Score Attack on Hardest difficulty. You may select any of “Unit” weapon types. Make sure you are set to “Very Hard” difficulty with “Save Replays” set to “On” in “SETTING EXZEAL”. Replays must be submitted to be counted. Stage 1 Score Attack can easily be unlocked by completing Stage 1 in Arcade Mode. The three highest scoring individuals on the leaderboard at the deadline below will each win the Triangle Service OST (on Steam) of their choice!
 
[b]Deadline:[/b]
The contest starts at EXZEAL’s launch, 7/14 US (7/15 Japan), and ends at 6pm PT on 7/21 in the US (10am on 7/22 in Japan).

EXZEAL is the fourth and final wave following the releases of the first wave, Shmups Skill Test...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430290
...the second wave, MINUS ZERO...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430300
...and the third wave, TRIZEAL Remix...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465070/
With these four waves defeated, the Shooting Love 20XX collection is yours!

notes.title: Shmups Skill Test Score Contest Results!
notes.content:
First a quick apology for the late results and a huge thank you to everyone who joined in with our contest (rules [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/430290/announcements/detail/950637823028983312]here[/url]) here and on Twitter.

If you had fun and would like to see more contests like this in the future, feel free to comment and tell us. We like to think the true joy of shmups is mastering the system and score mechanics and leaving your name in history on the scoreboard, so if the players demand it, we will do our best to rise to the challenge.

Before the results, a quick word of apology regards the rules: the English & Japanese wording differed slightly so we have adjusted the number of winners to account for that.
The English rules stated youngest ages would win, whereas the Japanese said 'aim for the youngest age', while also saying 'top 3 scores will win'. 
In the interests of fairness, we would like to award the 3 youngest ages [b]and[/b] the 3 top scores.

So here are the winners:

[h1]Youngest 3 Ages [/h1]
turskain
Mr....ah...
Mutsumi Bouken

[h1]Top 3 Scores[/h1]
Kariage
turskain
sn tak

Please send a friend request to me so we can deliver your EXZEAL Remix key asap!

And here's the Scoreboard in all its glory:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238058/dfe4186f2bc021e1962bb1ce7da92bece6be8bf7.jpg[/img][url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25238058/dfe4186f2bc021e1962bb1ce7da92bece6be8bf7.jpg]

We like to think the true joy of shmups is mastering the system and score mechanics and leaving your name in history on the scoreboard, so if the players demand it, we will do our best to rise to the challenge.

Before the results, a quick word of apology regards the rules: the English & Japanese wording differed slightly so we have adjusted the number of winners to account for that.
The English rules stated youngest ages would win, whereas the Japanese said 'aim for the youngest age', while also saying 'top 3 scores will win'. 
In the interests of fairness, we would like to award the 3 youngest ages [b]and[/b] the 3 top scores.

So here are the winners:

[h1]Youngest 3 Ages [/h1]
turskain
Mr....ah...
Mutsumi Bouken

[h1]Top 3 Scores[/h1]
Kariage
turskain
sn tak

Please send a friend request to me so we can deliver your EXZEAL Remix key asap!

And here's the Scoreboard in all its glory:

notes.title: Shmups Skill Test is Now Available with Contest! Shooting Love 20XX Second Wave, MINUS ZERO, Arrives on June 16th!
notes.content:
[h1]Shmups Skill Test Contests[/h1]

Celebrating the release of Shmups Skill Test, there are two Shmups Skill Test contests. You may enter both.

[b]Lowest Gamer Age Contest Rules[/b]
 Contestants will play in Solo Test mode. The 3 lowest “gamer age” entries submitted in Solo Test mode win. Matching gamer ages will be tie-broken by highest scores. Replays must be uploaded for entries to be counted.

[b]Prizes[/b]: All three winners each get a TRIZEAL Remix Steam key (given before official launch!)

[b]Mystery Age Contest Rules[/b]
Contestants will play in Solo Test mode. The first three contestants to achieve one of three different mystery ages and post their screenshot to Twitter mentioning and following @DegiGames and using #ShmupsAge win. Once a mystery age is achieved, no other contestant can submit the same age. The mystery ages are Fujino-san’s age, the amount of years since Gradius 3 (the game that inspired Fujino-san to design games) came out, and the amount of shots a second that Takahashi Meijin is famous for firing.

[b]Prizes[/b]: All three winners each get a beautiful, signed poster covered in XIIZEAL and DELTAZEAL ships.

[b]Deadlines[/b]:
Both contests start at Shmups Skill Test’s launch, 6/09 US (6/10 Japan), and end at 6pm PT on 6/16 in the US (10am on 6/17 in Japan).

[h1]MINUS ZERO[/h1] is coming to Steam.

Triangle Service’s MINUS ZERO is a shooter that focuses on a tried-and-true shoot-’em-up weapon: the lock-on laser. It’s shoot-’em-up purity: just you, your lock-on laser, and a whole bunch of enemies. As long as you continue to blast away at the waves of enemies, you’ll maintain invincibility, but if you lose track of your position amongst the explosions and neon glow, you’ll soon find that invincibility can be fleeting!

store.steampowered.com/app/430300/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/430290/extras/20xx_SLlogo.png[/img]

Following MINUS ZERO, two more waves will be released containing TRIZEAL Remix, and EXZEAL respectively. With these four waves defeated, the Shooting Love 20XX collection will be yours.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Shmups Skill Test, 20% off!
notes.content:
Shmups Skill Test is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off!*

Some say you’re only as old as you feel. Shmups Skill Test says you’re only as old as you shoot! Shmups Skill Test is a clever way to evaluate your shmup skills in the form of a "gamer age". Challenge and unlock shoot-’em-up-based minigames in a gauntlet of shmup nostalgia goodness.
